components: pointed hooked head and deep bowl
strokeOrder: sweep left through the pointed upper head
continue down and around the deep bowl without lifting
lift once, then place the dot above

strokeOrderSource.citation: Zer o Zabar, Ḳhe, ze, zāl, swād, and zwād, independent خ handwriting animation and Ḳhe instructions (Northwestern University Libraries Open Textbook, 2026)

This learner path covers the independent form and fits the course's vendored Noto Naskh fallback; Urdu is conventionally printed in Nastaliq, and the app's true Nastaliq face remains separate from this canonical script-data fallback.
